ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the food web diagram that is shown, which is the producer?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: In the image is a food web/trophic level diagram: on the left side are sequentially labeled Sun, Green plants, Herbivores, Carnivores, Bacteria and fungi, and it is accompanied by illustrations of the sun, green plants, animals, and decomposers. On the right side, at the position on the same level as green plants, it is labeled Primary producers. Reasoning: the question asks who the producer in this food web is; in the image, "Green plants" corresponds to "Primary producers", and in ecology, green plants can make their own food and belong to producers. Therefore the answer is green plants.
